decisions.reason: A core-adjacent track spotlight line with its own page in two consecutive years, signalling satisfactory results against aspirations in a growing industry, gives no trigger for problemistic search.
A ceiling luminaire line presented continuously since 2023 fits the established offer and appears to meet aspirations, so the firm has no reason to drop it.
A newly launched flexible spotlight line with its own page and close fit to the core portfolio, whose uncertain early results can be carried with the slack of a broad-range firm in a growing market.
A multi-outlet canopy is a low-cost complementary accessory that supports system sales, so it is unlikely to fall below aspirations enough to justify withdrawal.
The low-voltage canopy complements the modular systems at little cost, though as a niche variant it carries slightly higher risk of rationalisation.

The glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, hinting at weaker prominence, but as a new line close to the core they will likely be given more time before any shortfall prompts search.
